corroborating_sources.title: A model for the interaction of high-energy particles in straight and bent crystals implemented in Geant4
corroborating_sources.actually_read: Sections 2.1 Continuum approximation, 2.2 Channeling, 2.3 Dechanneling, extracted lines 99-179.
corroborating_sources.raw_short_excerpt: Under channeling conditions positive particles penetrate deeper into the crystal relative to the un-aligned orientation because the trajectory is repelled from the nuclei.
corroborating_sources.note: Original 2014 model paper explicitly gives transverse-energy trapping, angle dependence, and different nuclear encounters for positive versus negative particles. Used as corroboration; classic Lindhard paper selected for the TSV.
